name: Monkey Do!
detailed_description:
Monkey Do! stars Mak, a mischievous monkey trapped in a run-down zoo. When Joe Tropical replaced all zoo workers with soulless off-brand robots, Mak knew it was time to break out. On his way to freedom, Mak will team up with other animals to create traps for robo-keepers and sabotage zoo attractions. However, the malicious zoo owner won’t make things easy: different types of robots and security systems will require Mak to use every ounce of his creativity to throw a real monkey wrench into Joe Tropical's plans. The zoo descends into total chaos as Mak gets closer to freedom!

What Makes it Fun?

HIGH ENERGY - The game is full of fast paced action, with thrilling chases, dynamic environmental destruction, and slapstick comedy that will keep you on your toes.

PLAY YOUR WAY – Each Enclosure is filled with choices, encouraging experimentation to accomplish your goals: sneak around keepers on the ground, climb up high to stay out of sight, or bait enemies into cleverly set traps.

CHAOTIC HUMOR – Team up with zoo animals and unleash their wild abilities in the most hilarious and unpredictable ways, causing mayhem and destruction along the way!

This game is still in development so please keep checking back to this page for new features, content, and information!

short_description: Monkey Do! is an action-packed adventure where you play as a mischievous monkey willing to make his great escape. Armed with a trusty wrench and rebel attitude, Mak will sabotage the zoo, lure robo-keepers into clever traps and turn animals into his partners-in-crime. Are you ready to Monkey?
